scope: Offline B9 experiment; no hardware deployment
revision: Structural model evidence is divided by a calibrated temperature before combining it with the acquired category prior. Conditional geometric hypotheses within each structure remain unchanged; structural mixture and marginal depth can change.

selection.unit: 24 new independent calibration objects, each averaged over four observation conditions

declaration: Revision was explicitly described to the user and frozen before held-out test evaluation and policy execution.

interval_revision.reason: Object coverage remains 21/24 in held-out set and mean width grows to 2.316 m; interval score worsens.

controlled_scene_adaptation.semantic_cue: ideal first-hit acquired instance/category, including neutral/swapped interventions
controlled_scene_adaptation.cross_layout_difference: Up to two float32 ULP depth differences can cross discrete history thresholds; disclosed in mechanism audit.

evidence_boundary: Prediction calibration, candidate changes, object surface gains and complete exploration efficiency are separate outcomes. All adverse and tied results are retained.
